headword: {耕作放棄地|こうさくほうきち}

definitions.explanation: Farmland that has gone uncultivated for a year or more and that its owner has no plans to farm again. A growing problem in rural Japan as farmers age.

examples.japanese: {耕作放棄地|こうさくほうきち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
{耕作放棄地|こうさくほうきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}した→戻す：02317_modosu⟧。
examples.english: We turned abandoned farmland back into fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦{跡継|あとつ}ぎ→跡継ぎ：14299_atotsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}え→増える：01183_fueru⟧、{耕作放棄地|こうさくほうきち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: As more farmers have no successor, abandoned farmland is spreading.

notes:
⟦{耕作|こうさく}→耕作：06617_kousaku⟧ (cultivation) + ⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧ (abandonment) + {地|ち} (land). A term from news and government reports.
